missed_P0_regressions.title: Report-only not structurally enforced: Bash patterns permit writes
missed_P0_regressions.description: allowed-tools pre-approves Bash(git diff:*) and Bash(rg:*), both of which can create/overwrite files. git diff --output=<file> redirects output to arbitrary paths; ripgrep --pre executes arbitrary programs. Contradicts spec.md:49-51, design.md:72, and command docs claiming all pre-approved tools are read-only.

missed_P0_regressions.title: candidate.sh report-only assertion misses file modifications
missed_P0_regressions.description: git status --porcelain alone doesn't catch: committed changes (tree reads clean), git checkout/reset, writes to .gitignored paths, or writes outside $WD (~/.claude/, /tmp). Future runs that commit or write externally will pass the invariant check falsely.

missed_P0_regressions.title: Schema example contradicts rule for confidence field
missed_P0_regressions.description: Example object shows 'confidence': 100, but rule at line 36 states finders leave it at 0. Finders copying the example emit 100.

missed_P0_regressions.title: Baseline grep pattern too narrow, silently accepts output mismatches
missed_P0_regressions.description: Loud-failure cross-check greps only 'found [1-9][0-9]* issue'; patterns like '3 findings', 'Issues found: 3', or refusals pass silently as empty baseline. Systematically misses baseline extraction failures.

missed_P0_regressions.title: Prompt injection via untrusted review text in extract and match scripts
missed_P0_regressions.description: extract.sh:14 and match.sh:17-19 interpolate untrusted review text; reviso-finder-prior-reviews ingests PR comments. Bounded by read-only tooling but vulnerable if tool restrictions weakened (see finding 1).

missed_P0_regressions.title: One concern per PR rule violated: 57 files, ~6 groups in single PR
missed_P0_regressions.description: CLAUDE.md states 'one concern per PR' and tasks.md:3 references this rule. Baseline flagged the same issue. Warrants rule amendment or exception note.

missed_P0_regressions.title: PR description: unit-tested with mocks claim unsupported
missed_P0_regressions.description: PR claims 'Majority + judge logic unit-tested with mocks' but no test files, fixtures, or mock harnesses appear in the 57 changed files.

missed_P0_regressions.title: Run provenance not recorded: reuses v0 baseline without tracking
missed_P0_regressions.description: No baseline.json in run dir. judge.sh reused v0 baseline but nothing records baseline_ref field for self-description.

claimed_wins_unverified.title: Root CLAUDE.md's Scope section contradicts the repo — plugin already landed but doc not updated
claimed_wins_unverified.description: Scope section reads 'The plugin itself — `.claude-plugin/`, `commands/`, `skills/`, `agents/`, and the `eval/` corpus — is not here yet.' This diff adds exactly that surface across 19 commits, but never updates CLAUDE.md. A reader will be misdirected to 'grep for TODO(plugin)' when the plugin has already landed. Fix: Update or remove the Scope section to reflect current state, e.g. replace with pointer to CONTRIBUTING.md's map.
